items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06393374 | Sponsor: Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC | Condition: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Zanzalintinib Versus Everolimus in Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Neuroendocrine Tumors (Phase 2/Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06943755 | Sponsor: Exelixis | Condition: Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumor (pNET), Extra-Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumor (epNET) | Phase: Phase 2/Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. The primary purpose of this study is to assess the effectiveness of zanzalintinib compared to everolimus in participants with previously treated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic neuroendocrine tumors.
